headline.hi: Bina Naapo, Seedha Coordinates Se Area Nikaalo!
headline.en: Find Area Directly from Coordinates — No Measuring!

subtext.hi: Agar area 0 aa jaaye, iska matlab points ek seedhi line mein hain — triangle bana hi nahi!
subtext.en: If the area comes out 0, it means the points lie on a straight line — no triangle was formed at all!

text.hi: Ek land surveyor ko plot ka area nikaalna hai, aur usके paas sirf teeno corners ke GPS coordinates hain — scale se naapna possible nahi. Coordinate geometry ka area formula exactly isi kaam aata hai. Aur agar kabhi teeno corners ek seedhi line mein nikal aayein (area=0), matlab wo plot hai hi nahi — ye 'Collinearity' check karne ka tarika bhi hai!
text.en: A land surveyor needs to find a plot's area, and has only the GPS coordinates of the three corners — measuring with a scale isn't possible. Coordinate geometry's area formula is exactly built for this. And if the three corners turn out to lie on one straight line (area=0), it means there's no plot at all — this is also how we check 'Collinearity'!

content.hi: Triangle ABC ka area, jiske vertices A(x₁,y₁), B(x₂,y₂), C(x₃,y₃) hain, seedha coordinates se nikaala ja sakta hai — bina koi height ya base naape.
content.en: The area of triangle ABC, with vertices A(x₁,y₁), B(x₂,y₂), C(x₃,y₃), can be found directly from coordinates — without measuring any height or base.

content.hi: Modulus (| |) isliye lagate hain kyunki area kabhi negative nahi hoti — vertices ka order (clockwise/anticlockwise) kabhi kabhi negative value de sakta hai, uska sirf sign ignore karte hain.
content.en: We use modulus (| |) because area can never be negative — the order of vertices (clockwise/anticlockwise) can sometimes give a negative value, we just ignore that sign.

content.hi: Collinearity ka golden rule: Agar teen points ek seedhi line mein hain, toh unse banne wale 'triangle' ka area 0 hoga (kyunki triangle bana hi nahi). Isliye check karne ke liye same area formula use karo — agar answer 0 aaye, points collinear hain.
content.en: Golden rule for collinearity: if three points lie on a straight line, the 'triangle' they form has area 0 (since no triangle was actually formed). So use the same area formula to check — if the answer is 0, the points are collinear.

content.hi: Quadrilateral ka area nikaalne ke liye, use diagonal se do triangles mein baant do, dono ka area nikaalo aur add kar do.
content.en: To find a quadrilateral's area, split it into two triangles using a diagonal, find each triangle's area, and add them.

caption.hi: Agar area formula se 0 mile, matlab teeno points ek seedhi line mein hain — koi triangle bana hi nahi.
caption.en: If the area formula gives 0, it means all three points lie on a straight line — no triangle was formed.

problem.en: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (1,2), (4,5), and (7,3).

problem.hi: Dikhao ki points (1,2), (3,4), aur (5,6) collinear hain.
problem.en: Show that the points (1,2), (3,4), and (5,6) are collinear.

steps.en: Area = 0, so the points are collinear ✓

problem.hi: Agar (2,3), (4,5), aur (x,2) wale triangle ka area 5 sq. units hai, toh x nikaalo.
problem.en: If the triangle with vertices (2,3), (4,5), and (x,2) has area 5 sq. units, find x.

question.hi: Agar teen points collinear hon, toh unse bane triangle ka area kya hoga?
question.en: If three points are collinear, what is the area of the triangle formed by them?

explanation.hi: Collinear points koi triangle nahi banate, isliye area 0 hota hai.
explanation.en: Collinear points don't form a triangle, so the area is 0.

question.hi: Area formula mein modulus (| |) kyun lagate hain?
question.en: Why do we use modulus (| |) in the area formula?

options.hi: Formula ko chhota karne ke liye

explanation.hi: Area hamesha positive hoti hai, isliye modulus se sign ignore karte hain.
explanation.en: Area is always positive, so modulus removes any negative sign.

question.hi: Quadrilateral ka area nikaalne ke liye use ek diagonal se 2 triangles mein baant sakte hain.
question.en: To find a quadrilateral's area, you can split it into 2 triangles using a diagonal.

explanation.hi: Sahi — dono triangles ka area nikaal ke add kar do.
explanation.en: True — find both triangles' areas and add them.

notes.hi: Collinearity check: same formula use karo — area=0 matlab collinear

notes.hi: Quadrilateral area = diagonal se 2 triangles mein baant ke dono ka sum
